name: @test-cabinet/simple-2d
description: The Simple 2D engine: the runtime a produced 2D game is built on. An engine is created over a canvas and bound to one game, and it owns the frame loop and its replaceable clock, the letterboxed device-pixel-ratio-aware canvas fit, named input actions over keyboard bindings and touch layouts, a pointer mapped into the game's logical coordinates, an audio cue bus with its first-gesture unlock, asset resolution under a fixed root, a diagnostics overlay, the debug surface a game returns beside its state, and an opt-in draw-command recorder whose recordings replay the frames a build drew — leaving the game to write only its own simulation and rendering. Everything it does is observed by subscribing to its events rather than by reading a log it accumulates.
